stage: P5.2.3 mechanism audit and candidate design only

baseline.source: evaluation/reports/p5_2_2_operation_level_real_provider_20261005T111410Z.json and its two referenced P5.2.2 run artifacts
baseline.sample_interpretation: two exploratory frozen-case runs; not production traffic, not a controlled A/B, and not a stable latency distribution
baseline.historical_effective_timeout_config: NOT_PERSISTED; current local configuration was audited separately and must not be retroactively assumed for the earlier runs
baseline.exact_scope_note: food-02 Claim Extraction succeeded on its first HTTP attempt. privacy-03 Claim Extraction timed out on both attempts and fell back. Separately, food-02 Legal review recovered on its retry. This supports a shared provider-timeout signal, but only one Claim Extraction retry event exists.

current_runtime_config_audit.source: loaded project environment in a local read-only inspection; secret values were not printed
current_runtime_config_audit.timeout_semantics: httpx.Client(timeout=30.0) phase timeout, not a single hard total logical-call deadline
current_runtime_config_audit.hard_maximum_logical_wall_time: UNKNOWN; phase/read timeout semantics do not establish one total wall-clock cap
current_runtime_config_audit.retry_payload: same URL, model, messages, temperature, and payload are reused; timeout and retry count do not change between attempts
current_runtime_config_audit.response_schema_enforced_by_provider: NO; response is parsed and validated after HTTP success

legal_call_path_audit.claim_extraction_parse_and_validation: extract_claims parses JSON, requires claims list, validates required Claim fields/source boundaries, then can fall back to deterministic _combine_claims on provider/parse/schema/validation error
legal_call_path_audit.model_and_provider_for_all_three: shared LLMClient runtime configuration; current runtime inspection and P5.2.2 artifact report openai_compatible / deepseek-v4-flash
legal_call_path_audit.loop_repeats_claim_extraction_after_obse: NO; Human Fact resume calls run_legal_action_loop with stored extraction/cursor and does not re-enter legal_agent.run/extract_claims
legal_call_path_audit.claim_extraction_call_frequency: once per fresh Legal Agent run; transport retries are internal attempts of that logical call

prompt_character_measurement.method: Character counts produced from the current prompt builder functions using frozen event strings plus fixed synthetic draft/red-team fixtures; system message included in total_messages_chars. Historical P5.2.2 reports do not persist prompt text or per-call input character counts.
prompt_character_measurement.fixture_disclaimer: These are reproducible fixture sizes, not historical prompt sizes and not token counts. Draft, red-team, retrieved-context, and ContextPack fields are synthetic/empty fixtures; no prompt content is persisted in this report.

legal_action_proposal.fixture: one structured Claim with two eligible actions, no raw Claim text in serialized decision context

prompt_character_measurement.relative_prompt_size_conclusion: On these fixed fixtures, Claim Extraction prompt is shorter than Legal review and proposal. Historical call-specific prompt sizes are unavailable, so prompt size is not supported as the timeout cause.

claim_extraction_specific_timeout.evidence: One of two Claim Extraction calls had two timeouts; one succeeded first try. A Legal review call also timed out under the shared client settings.
claim_extraction_specific_timeout.not_proven: An extraction-only latency or prompt-size cause

general_provider_timeout.evidence: Timeout attempts occurred in both Claim Extraction and Legal review and lasted about 30 seconds. This aligns with the currently loaded 30-second setting, but the exact effective timeout configuration was not persisted for the historical runs; two frozen exploratory runs only.

retry_policy_inefficiency_for_claim_extr.evidence: The sole observed Claim Extraction retry also timed out; however, a Legal review retry recovered, so retry value cannot be generalized across operations or inferred from one extraction failure.

prompt_size_as_timeout_cause.evidence: No per-call prompt character counts are persisted; safe fixture sizes are short, but do not reconstruct actual past prompts or prove latency causality.

schema_or_parse_failure_as_timeout_cause.evidence: P5.2.2 recorded zero parse failures and zero schema failures; the affected Claim Extraction call failed at provider transport timeout before parsing.

generation_budget_as_timeout_cause.evidence: No max_tokens is sent. One successful Claim Extraction returned 6,718 observed output tokens, but output-token semantics are UNKNOWN and the timeout attempts supplied no usage.

duplicate_claim_extraction_due_to_legal_.evidence: The Human Fact continuation uses persisted extraction plus cursor to resume the bounded loop; the two-run artifact records two extraction logical calls total, one per fresh case run.

candidate_selection.primary_candidate: For evaluation only, set max_retries=0 for legal.claim_extraction while preserving the existing one-retry default for every other operation. Preserve the same prompt, model, temperature, timeout, parsing, validation, deterministic fallback, Legal policy, and workflow.
candidate_selection.why_this_candidate: It isolates the one observed extraction path where the sole retry did not recover and avoids changing shared timeout behavior despite a timeout also occurring in Legal review. It is reversible and directly testable; evidence is weak and does not establish that it is beneficial.
candidate_selection.expected_benefit_hypothesis: Lower Claim Extraction logical-call latency and HTTP attempts when the first extraction attempt times out and a retry would also fail.
candidate_selection.primary_metric: Mean Claim Extraction logical-call latency per frozen case, reported separately by case and paired run; timeout-affected calls also shown explicitly.
hard_safety_gates: Claim Extraction fallback rate must not increase versus baseline in the observed paired sample.
No reduction in material Claim coverage or frozen expected fact-gap coverage; assess with a rubric frozen before any run.
No increase in unsupported Claims, parse/schema failures, or unsafe fact attribution.
Human Fact remains human_asserted and all downstream Safety/Human Review outcomes remain valid; no bypasses.
candidate_selection.acceptance_rule: Only consider the candidate if per-case paired latency is directionally lower and every hard safety gate passes. Any fallback/coverage/safety regression rejects it. If the small sample is noisy or mixed, classify INCONCLUSIVE and retain baseline; do not claim statistical significance.

rejected_candidates.reason: A timeout also occurred in Legal review; a longer wait does not isolate Claim Extraction and current HTTPX setting is not a total logical-call deadline.
Would multiply waits/calls across all operations; no evidence justifies broadening retries.
No parse/schema failure evidence; could reduce required material Claim recall and confounds timeout attribution.
No baseline cap or output-truncation evidence; risk of silently omitting Claims; no token limit should be guessed.
Not isolated from the observed transport timeout and outside this candidate's single-variable boundary.

future_p5_2_4_design.baseline: Current code and runtime: legal.claim_extraction max_retries=1 (up to 2 HTTP attempts); all other settings unchanged.
future_p5_2_4_design.candidate: CE-RETRY-0 only: legal.claim_extraction max_retries=0 (1 HTTP attempt). No production default change during this design stage.
future_p5_2_4_design.repetitions: 3 paired repetitions per case; randomize baseline/candidate order within each pair; 6 pairs total, 12 complete frozen Case runs across both arms.
future_p5_2_4_design.budget_basis: P5.2.2 observed 15 workflow logical LLM calls over two frozen runs (9 and 6), average 7.5; 12 future runs implies approximately 90. This is a planning estimate only; Legal-only estimate is approximately 54 logical calls based on 9 Legal calls across the two runs. HTTP attempts and cost are unknown and may differ by arm.
controlled_variables: case inputs and frozen Human Fact response
future_p5_2_4_design.primary_analysis: Compare paired Claim Extraction logical-call latency per case; report attempt count, fallback, usage availability, extracted Claim coverage, parse/schema status, and downstream safety outcomes as guardrails.
future_p5_2_4_design.interpretation_boundary: Small exploratory paired experiment only; provider nondeterminism and N=3 per case/arm prevent statistical or production-level claims. If no qualifying first-attempt timeout occurs, result is INSUFFICIENT_EXPOSURE, not evidence of no effect.
